summary: SmartFix security hardening pass — 119 tests total (99 legacy regression + 20 new security tests). Legacy suites (backend_test.py + test_roles_audit.py + test_smartfix_platform.py) all 99 pass after minimal test-side updates required by the SEC-002 behavior change: fixtures now read `dev_otp` from response instead of assuming hardcoded '123456'; deprecated 409-on-duplicate assertion replaced with 200+no-dev_otp; TestQuotations no longer expects GET /quotations/{id} to return raw token (P3: token returned only at CREATE + SEND). New /app/backend/tests/test_security_hardening.py — 20/20 pass — asserts every SEC-* fix and P3 hardening: SEC-001 DEV_MODE gate (reset_token/dev_otp only in DEV; production stripped per code inspection), SEC-002 random OTP + no user enumeration (already-registered returns generic 200 with NO dev_otp, two consecutive requests for same NEW mobile produce different OTPs, old OTP is invalidated), SEC-003 deactivation locks existing bearer token AND blocks fresh login with 401 'Account is deactivated' (reactivate restores), SEC-004 subprocess import with placeholder JWT_SECRET raises RuntimeError, rate limits (login >10/min, forgot-password >5/min, request-otp >5/min all 429), CORS pins to allow_origin_regex (evil origin NOT echoed, emergent-preview origin IS echoed), quotation token P3 (create returns raw token+public_url once, GET does not leak, DB row has only token_hash 64-char sha256, /send rotates so old token 404s and new token resolves), password min length 8 (register-complete + reset-password 7-char = 422, 8-char = 200). One CDN/infra observation: through the public preview URL, the ingress/CDN edge injects `access-control-allow-origin: *` on top of the backend response — backend middleware itself pins correctly (verified against localhost:8001), so this is an edge-layer concern, not a backend regression. Rate limits are enforced by slowapi via `get_remote_address` (request.client.host) which through Cloudflare varies per edge IP — verified against localhost:8001 where limits fire deterministically at the 11th/6th request.

minor.issue: Public preview URL responds with `access-control-allow-origin: *` for ANY origin — the K8s ingress / Cloudflare adds a wildcard CORS header on top of the backend's origin-pinned response. Backend middleware is correct (verified via localhost:8001), but browsers hitting the public URL still see the wildcard. Consider disabling ingress CORS or configuring it to defer to upstream.

Rate limiter uses `get_remote_address` which returns `request.client.host` — through Cloudflare each request may originate from a different edge IP, weakening real-world enforcement. Recommend switching key_func to a wrapper that prefers `X-Forwarded-For[0]` when present (and only trust it behind a known proxy).

action_items: Fix ingress-layer CORS wildcard override so backend's allow_origin_regex is what the browser actually sees (see minor issue #1).
Harden slowapi key_func to use X-Forwarded-For (behind trusted proxy) so login/forgot/request-otp rate limits are per real client IP, not per CF edge (see minor issue #2).

Optional: legacy backend_test.py `test_login_wrong_password` and test_roles_audit.py `test_new_customer_sees_no_data` are flaky when the entire suite runs in parallel because they consume login/OTP budget from the same IP window — pass in isolation. Consider adding 429-retry helpers or serializing auth-heavy tests, or bumping the rate window for DEV_MODE.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 gate is correctly placed inside `if DEV_MODE:` blocks in both /forgot-password and /register/request-otp; unknown user still returns generic 200 without leak.

SEC-002 gen_otp() uses secrets.randbelow(1_000_000) — cryptographically random, 6-digit zero-padded; already-registered branch returns identical message with NO dev_otp field, defeating enumeration via response-shape diffing.
SEC-003 enforced in BOTH current_user() (rejects existing tokens whose user has active=False) and /auth/login (rejects fresh login) with matching 401 'Account is deactivated' text.
SEC-004 fail-fast at module import checks JWT_SECRET.lower() against ('changeme','change-in-prod','placeholder') — raises RuntimeError before AsyncIOMotorClient is constructed.

P3 quotation: raw token is generated once, only token_hash persisted (DB doc verified has no `token` key, only `token_hash` = 64-char sha256). /send generates a NEW random token, replaces token_hash — old raw token 404s. Verified end-to-end.
P3 password: Field(min_length=8) applied on CompleteRegIn.password, ResetIn.new_password, and hash_password — 7-char inputs correctly rejected with 422 at Pydantic layer.
Test-side migration was needed for OTP handling — SEC-002's per-request randomness is incompatible with previous hardcoded '123456' fixture; updated 4 fixtures to read `dev_otp` from response.
